results.title: Camarada Cunhal
results.overview: July 1956. Álvaro Cunhal arrives at Peniche Fort and is placed in the most modern and secure prison wing, considered escape-proof. Despite the tight control exercised over the prisoners, Álvaro and his comrades manage to organize a small commune and provide support to the most vulnerable detainees, while looking for a way to escape.

results.title: FASCISM(s): A Film in Six Parts
results.original_title: FASCISMO(s): Um Filme em Seis Partes
results.overview: Six sequences about Fascism and its segments throughout history.

results.title: SPIRIT
results.overview: Haunted by a familiar ghost, Trevor's sleepless night turns into a never ending chase for his best friend.

results.title: Norbert
results.overview: Norbert an incompetent spy from a sad, bureaucratic and grey nation will become a key player to thwart the plans of his own government, in an exciting quest that will see him travel alongside strange companions.

results.title: Nightcap
results.overview: Two young couples, childhood friends, reunite at a prom after years. As they continue the party in an apartment, hidden emotional wounds and past traumas begin to surface during one intense night.

results.title: Nia
results.overview: After an 18-year-old street vendor is brutally murdered on her way home, her grieving family and heartbroken boyfriend seek closure while her killer flees the law, pursued by intense guilt.

results.title: Ghost Fish
results.overview: Isla emerges from the river and gets a job at a tropical fish store while metaphysical and physical forces work against her.

results.title: Atropia
results.overview: When an aspiring actress in a military role-playing facility falls in love with a soldier cast as an insurgent, their unsimulated emotions threaten to derail the performance.

results.title: Schadenfreude
results.overview: A woman rejoices in the misfortune of others and tries to justify it.

results.title: Sandra
results.overview: Sandra is an insurance broker staying at a hotel with her team for a training session led by a famous coach. When a mysterious phone call wakes her in her room, she realizes she is being watched by a foreign guest.

results.title: Our Girls
results.overview: A near-fatal accident involving their teen daughters upends the lives of two families as they consider how far they're willing to go to save their child.

results.title: Karmadonna
results.overview: A pregnant woman receives ultimatums from a supernatural entity to commit murders or face the death of her unborn child.

results.title: The Daughter
results.overview: A day at the beach turns sinister when ten-year-old Lana spies her father’s interactions with a young woman.

results.title: La Durmiente
results.overview: During a dynastic crisis in 14th century Portugal, the 10 year old Beatriz enters into a forced marriage to become the country’s new queen. At the Monastery of Sancti Spiritus in Toro, where the tomb of Beatriz is located, this story is re-enacted, re-imagined, and recreated with children of the same age. As their imagination is allowed to roam free, a different way to interact with their country’s history opens up.

results.title: Creature Feature
results.overview: A coming-of-age diary of “Leonor Will Never Die”.

results.title: The Fly
results.overview: Inspired by Marcel Marceau’s The Hands, The Fly is the first in a short film trilogy of experimental horror, based on Elf Lyons’ one-woman show RAVEN.

results.title: Fish Head
results.overview: Ofelia is a 17-year-old girl who wastes her time hanging out with her friend Daphne, baking pot brownies and selling them around town. One day, while visiting her friend's workplace, she is captivated by a newly arrived fish. On impulse, she decides to steal it. However, this separates the two friends. Ofelia decides to look for Daphne in all the places they used to hang out.

results.title: Mother Grimm
results.overview: An encounter of a mother is unexpected when the daughter needs help.
